pull_request.title: Show the customer's order history
pull_request.body: Lists every order for a customer.

files.patch:
@@ -20,0 +21,4 @@
+def history(customer):
+    for order in customer.orders:
+        rows.append(db.get("select * from items where order = %s", order.id))
+    return rows

rubric.criteria: Says what grows and with what, rather than naming a complexity class.

levels.5: One query per order, so a customer with hundreds of orders makes hundreds of round trips — stated in terms of production, with the line.
levels.3: Flags the query in the loop without saying what it costs in practice.
levels.1: Misses it, or reports a micro-optimization instead.
